Posts.RecruitPostName: 腾讯游戏海外发行市场经理-东南亚
Posts.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1. 负责新品东南亚核心市场的营销工作，包括整体营销策略制定，内容营销工作，创意Campaign策划与落地；
2. 能够有效分析产品内核与玩法内核，筛选并明确目标用户、分析用户诉求、提炼核心卖点，并结合市场环境、产品阶段输出市场营销方案；
3. 为各类事件、营销内容制定和规划执行效果目标，与核心业务指标关联，对产品的内容声量、传播效率、用户转化效率负责；
4. 基于传播视角，与产品、社区、创意等团队配合，设计传播方案，推进游戏内外资源整合，落地执行。

岗位要求
1. 3年以上游戏营销或市场行业工作经验， 有手游产品全周期发行经验，有东南亚港澳台市场营销经验者优先；
2. 对游戏行业熟悉且充满热情，有深度游戏产品体验经历；
3. 市场触觉敏锐，喜欢创意，能够快速抓住游戏用户偏好，对游戏内容生态有较深理解 ；
4. 具备良好的沟通协调能力和执行落地能力，善于多线程、跨团队的沟通协作；
5. 可用英文作为主要工作语言。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会
在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
Work Location: China-Shenzhen

岗位职责
负责海外头部二次元手游的长线玩法拓展。该岗位将作为发行侧的核心设计专家，深度参与引导外部研发团队合作，主导游戏内新增的常驻玩法模块开发和落地。1. 负责游戏内新常驻玩法的核心玩法设计与规划，主导产品方向，负责玩法框架/数值框架搭建与平衡性调优，确保玩法的策略深度与长线可玩性。
2. 研发协同与监修：作为发行侧的“设计主导”，引导研发团队，并推动研发团队落地执行和调优。
3. 生态构建与商业化结合：设计新玩法与主线养成的资源循环机制，规划该玩法的赛季制更新节奏及配套的奖励/荣誉体系。

岗位要求
1、资历背景：
* 5年以上游戏策划经验，具备一线研发经验（曾任职于研发团队的系统/战斗/数值策划）。
* 有完整项目从0到1或大型资料片开发经验者优先。
2、专业能力：
* 精通策略体系设计： 对卡牌对战、回合制策略、战棋或即时对抗类玩法有极深的研究。 擅长处理多单位协同、技能羁绊、以及复杂的数值平衡，有能力构建高自由度的策略环境。
* 能独立输出高标准的系统案，对平衡性测试有一定的经验。
* 对实体桌游有不错的理解优先。
3、用户理解：
* 二次元重度用户，深刻理解“角色”在二次元游戏中的核心价值，懂得如何通过玩法机制放大角色魅力。
* 对全球主流产品及其衍生玩法有深入体验。

Posts.RecruitPostName: Tencent Youtu Lab Research Intern - Multimodal Large Language Models (2026 Project UP) 106722
Posts.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Tencent Youtu Lab is seeking a highly motivated Research Intern to join our 2026 Project UP initiative, focusing on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This role is ideal for postgraduate students passionate about AI research and looking to contribute to the next generation of intelligent systems. The intern will engage in cutting-edge R&D involving the integration and understanding of diverse data types such as image, text, audio, and video. You will work alongside top researchers to explore advanced techniques like multimodal pre-training, long-video interaction, and visual reasoning, bridging theoretical innovation with real-world applications. This is a unique opportunity to develop impactful solutions, contribute to open-source or academic outputs, and push the frontier of AI at Tencent Cloud.ResponsibilitiesCore Research & Development: Conduct advanced research on technical solutions for Multimodal Large Models (MLLMs), focusing on the perception, understanding, and interaction of mixed modalities including image, text, audio, and video. Explore cutting-edge topics such as native multimodal pre-training schemes, long-video interactive understanding, visual reasoning, and multimodal agents.
Innovation & Breakthroughs: Keep pace with state-of-the-art (SOTA) trends in the multimodal large model field. Combine theoretical research with actual business scenarios to explore innovative solutions, achieve technical breakthroughs, and build industry-leading multimodal large language models.
Industry Impact: Produce influential research outcomes and contribute to the advancement of multimodal large model technologies within the industry through high-quality papers or open-source projects.

Who We Look For
Currently pursuing a postgraduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related fields, familiar with key research achievements and mainstream open-source projects in the field of multimodal large language models. Demonstrated strong academic research capabilities with a track record of results, and practical experience in solving concrete algorithmic problems.
Strong algorithm implementation skills with proficiency in Python. Demonstrate extensive knowledge of mainstream deep learning platforms and algorithmic frameworks applied in Multimodal Large Models (MLLMs) and foundation models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Passionate about tackling challenging technical problems and possesses a strong spirit of teamwork and collaboration.
Excellent proficiency in both English and Chinese Mandarin, written and spoken, to effectively collaborate with global research and engineering teams.

Posts.RecruitPostName: WeChat Payのシニアエリアマネージャー（日本）
Posts.Responsibility:
部署紹介/Business Unit
全世界で12億人以上のユーザーを誇る WeChat は、中国と世界中の人々、サービス、企業をつなぎ、モバイルの未来を大きく変革しています。海外市場で WeChat Pay として知られる Weixin Pay は、2013年にWeixinによって導入されたモバイル決済ソリューションです。銀行口座と Weixin Pay アカウントを連携させることで、ユーザーは迅速かつ便利で、安全な決済や取引をスムーズに完了できます。
中国国内では、Weixin Pay は日常生活のあらゆる場面に溶け込み、オンラインまたはオフラインを問わず、小売、飲食、交通、ヘルスケア、レジャーといったさまざまな分野で、効率的かつスマートな決済サービスを提供しています。日本においては、WeChat Pay チームが日本市場全体でのサービス拡大に尽力しています。
With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is an Internet-based platform company founded in Shenzhen, China, in 1998. We use technology to enrich the lives of Internet users and assist the digital upgrade of enterprises. Our mission is "Value for Users, Tech for Good". We embrace a culture of teamwork & creativity and are driven by our values - Integrity, Proactivity, Collaboration and Creativity.
We are rapidly expanding our international operations and are looking for top talent to propel us forward. Combining the results-oriented nature of a startup with the resources of a profitable and leading Internet company, Tencent offers a unique opportunity for aspiring individuals to thrive.
About WeChat Pay
With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner. 
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.
【仕事内容】
1.主な目標は、日本のWeChat決済加盟店の効果的なカバレッジと市場シェアを改善することです。
2.日本のビジネス形態、加盟店、開拓チャネルの完全な理解に基づいて、市場機会を発見し、WeChatとTencentのリソースを統合し、地域拡販計画を策定し、エグゼキューションを効果的に実施します。
3.日本におけるWeChat Payの健全な発展を達成するために、地域のサービスプロバイダーおよびパートナーの管理および事業開発を実施します。

応募資格/Who We Look For
【応募要件】
1.中国語および日本語ビジネスレベル以上、優れたビジネス開発および交渉スキル、3年以上の関連する実務経験。
2.日本の市場およびビジネス文化に理解し、市場について明確かつ正確な洞察を得て、それを実際の実行戦略に変換できる。
3.決済または関連業界の実務経験があり、決済業界の操作形態にしており、加盟店またはチャネルの拡大に関連する経験がある。
